anomalies.description: A silver minivan swerves sharply to the left while approaching a cyclist, colliding with or narrowly missing the cyclist at approximately 6.0 seconds, then continues forward and turns right, showing signs of impact (tilted orientation, possible damage).
A silver sedan is immobilized with wheel clamps (boots) on its front wheels; a tow truck arrives and begins attaching a towing mechanism to the rear of the vehicle.

A white truck in the middle lane suddenly swerves left, colliding with or forcing a smaller white car (ahead and to its left) into the red guardrail; the white car is visibly pushed sideways and appears to impact the barrier between frames f12 and f15.
